w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Buffering, The Loud Beast, Spool, The Terms of Service) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
